{{Quote|There are those unscrupulous individuals who are attempting to take advantage of a distracted Republic. We will not turn a blind eye to this. Every erg of energy illegally obtained may as well have been handed over to charge the weapons Count Dooku has pointed at us.|Kachariss Weng|<ref name="Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:4:14">{{InsiderCite|67|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:4:14}}</ref>}}
[[Price Administrator]] '''Kachariss Weng''' was an individual who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following the announcement in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] that the [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Rangers]] were to investigate on breaches of the Republic's [[Victory Rationing Orders and Regulation Plan]], Weng was quoted in a [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] report on the crackdown.
